name: SyliusBonusPointsPlugin
description: The plugin extends Sylius with simple bonus points loyalty program and applies special actions for users depending on the points score.

paragraphs: Deprecation note. This repository is not maintained anymore. For an alternative please use the Sylius Plus Loyalty Plugin.

We want to impact many unique eCommerce projects and build our brand recognition worldwide, so we are heavily involved in creating open-source solutions, especially for Sylius. We have already created over 35 extensions, which have been downloaded almost 2 million times.
